body.name: Ordinary full-kernel source family \(\mathcal Q_{\mathbf B}\)
body.construction:
For \(\mathbf B=(B_1,\ldots,B_t)\), set
\[
 \mathcal Q_{\mathbf B}
 =\{Q[V\setminus B_i](\cdot;b):i\in[t],\ b\in\mathfrak X_{B_i}\}
 =\{P_b(V\setminus B_i):i\in[t],\ b\in\mathfrak X_{B_i}\}.
\]
The collection \(\mathbf B\) is ordinary full-kernel identifying exactly when the complete ordinary single-world procedure accepts every cell of \(Q[S_0]\) from this full finite source family.  Its permitted deterministic preprocessing consists of marginals and conditionals whose displayed denominators are positive; cells not used as denominators need not be positive.
